BiblicalUsage: Kelajah is a Levite named once. He stands in the list of those who had taken strange wives: also of the Levites, Jozabad, and Shimei, and Kelaiah, the same is Kelita, and Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
TheologicalSignificance: One line is all we have for him, and I hold that the record is enough, because God counts the Levites by name.
